purpose: This table provides cleaned, typed hourly weather observations (temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, precipitation, visibility) for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) in 2013, intended to feed downstream analyses that join weather conditions to flight or operational events by airport and hour.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour (now a TIMESTAMP) to align with flight or event data at the same airport and hour; treat wind_gust as frequently absent (about 75% null) and pressure, wind_dir, and wind_speed as occasionally absent, so aggregate functions should skip nulls rather than treat them as zero.
limitations: wind_gust is sparsely populated (null_rate 0.745505) and should not be relied on for complete coverage; pressure (null_rate 0.114953), wind_dir (null_rate 0.016828), and wind_speed (null_rate 0.000154) also carry some nulls that are retained rather than imputed; capture-tool metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped and carry no business history.
